I can't tell you your blood glucose for October 2, 2026, because the local database has no blood glucose records at all. The only data stored is daily step counts for October 1–3, 2026. I didn't substitute steps or any other metric.

Blood glucose may simply not have been imported yet, or it may not have been granted. I can try importing the blood glucose category for that date. That would need a connected account, and I haven't checked whether one is connected. Do you want me to try?

Fitbit and Google Health only have glucose data if you log it manually or sync a compatible device, such as a continuous glucose monitor. If none of those is linked, there may be nothing to import.
